description.en: A Turtle slice of a schema.org-style vocabulary (classes, data types and properties with domainIncludes / rangeIncludes, English and Chinese labels). The new release inserts SocialMediaPosting and FoodEstablishment and moves classes under them, deprecates Code and employees with IAO:0100001 replacements, fixes labels and comments, and adds an OWL existential restriction.
description.zh-CN: schema.org 风格词汇表的 Turtle 片段（类、数据类型、带 domainIncludes / rangeIncludes 的属性，中英文标签）。新版本插入 SocialMediaPosting 与 FoodEstablishment 并把已有类移到其下，以 IAO:0100001 废弃并替换 Code 与 employees，修正标签和注释，并新增一条 OWL 存在量词约束。
